assumptions: Step 4 landed as 0a11c42d3e373fe9b45e826a3015c93bb7cf4704, which is this branch's base. The audit reports the Step 4 shape, so this step adds no new report fields

A scheduled audit must be read-only BY CONSTRUCTION, not by luck of its environment. reconcileFlow decides whether to mutate from the live sole-orchestrator marker, and a hosted runner merely HAPPENS not to hold one. reportOnlyFlowIo removes the capability instead of relying on its absence: the marker reads as gone and every mutation hook throws if reached, so a regression fails loudly rather than writing

Three exit codes, not two. Expiry needs a human decision; an unreadable or malformed state means the instrument is broken and must fail closed. An hourly job that reported both as one number would train its operator to ignore both. 0 clean, 2 expired, 3 unverifiable, and unverifiable outranks expiry because an audit that could not read everything is not trusted to have seen the expiry either

The workflow files nothing and is granted no permission that could. contents, issues and pull-requests are all read, so the promise 'this job never files an issue' is structural rather than a property of what its steps happen to do; the failing run and its job summary are the report
No push or pull_request trigger, on purpose: expiry is created by time passing and changes no file, so no commit-shaped trigger could catch it and a paths filter would be dishonest

The 'no mutating flag on a schedule' rule is about scheduled runs generally, not about this one file, so the policy test scans every scheduled workflow in the directory and carries a positive control asserting the scan found this workflow at all

Prose comments naming a trigger or a command to explain why it is ABSENT are not declarations or call sites, so the policy tests scan non-comment lines; without that, the workflow's own header comment would fail the test it satisfies

The ai-devops orchestrator skill half of this step is a separate synchronized change in popcre/ai-devops, not a hand edit of the installed copy. check-skill-drift.mjs reads the canonical ai-devops skills and must still report no contradictions against AGENTS.md after it lands
